ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-06-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor / and Gender.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Sandra Gonzalez (mother), present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Salvador Alvarado Gonzalez Jr. The minor's father, Salvador Alvarado, was present. Parties were sworn and examined.
Mr. Alvarado signed the petition to agree to the name change of minor in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
Decree signed in open court.
